title: Rappenkrieg (Basel)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Rappenkrieg (Basel)", at revision 1354447555, opens: "The Rappenkrieg was a peasant uprising lasting from 1591–1594, involving a conflict between the Swiss city of Basel and the surrounding Prince-Bishopric of Basel. The uprising was caused by the increase in the rate of sales tax on wine and meat. After several years the conflict was ended through negotiations headed up by the Basel merchant turned politician Andreas Ryff." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q670984, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "peasant uprising lasting from 1591–1594". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
